public_service_atom.zh: 在零电、断网、无模型状态下，人仍可沿连续无障碍阴影路径穿过一个可交换但不直送噪声的地面层，并在静侧停留。
public_service_atom.en: With power, network and model off, a person can still cross an exchange-capable ground layer on a continuous accessible shaded path without a direct noise path, and can pause on the quiet side.

causal_contract.headline_zh: 让地面打开，不让噪声直送到人。
causal_contract.headline_en: OPEN THE GROUND, NOT A DIRECT NOISE PATH.
causal_contract.source: verified traffic/equipment/activity/emission source or explicitly UNKNOWN hypothesis
causal_contract.path: sealed, straight-through, or staggered/shaded/buffered ground section
causal_contract.receiver: walking, learning, waiting, working or resting human surface

mechanisms.data: not evidenced as an open one-north district-data right

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 把首层分成时限模块、公开证据窗与受控试场；每个模块单独核查疏散、无障碍、声热路径和复原。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Split the ground floor into time-limited modules, a public evidence window and controlled test space; each module separately clears egress, accessibility, sound/heat paths and restoration.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: JTC的土地与主开发权、园区规模和未来项目不能移植；Punggol数字平台不在one-north。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: JTC land/master-developer powers, scale and future projects do not transfer; the Punggol digital platform is not at one-north.

global_case_studies.name_zh: 法国 Paris-Saclay / DATAIA / Jean Zay

mechanisms.land: public development authority coordinating a mixed urban campus
mechanisms.space: station district, research/teaching, housing, public realm and demonstrators
mechanisms.finance: public programme context; amounts and commitments do not transfer
mechanisms.talent: multi-institution AI research and training network
mechanisms.compute: reviewed applications and regular/dynamic public research allocations
mechanisms.data: controlled storage/model/dataset infrastructure with provenance duties
mechanisms.scenario: authorised urban demonstrators linked to professional project controls

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 算力留在受控后台或外部节点；首层只承载申请—配给—运行—能耗/来源—结果—删除/归档的审计界面。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Keep compute in a controlled back-end or external node; the ground floor carries only the auditable request-allocation-run-energy/provenance-result-delete/archive interface.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: 国家科研联盟、超算规模、France 2030与热网不能外推为京张资源或工程方案。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: The national research alliance, supercomputer scale, France 2030 status and heat network cannot be inferred as Jing-Zhang resources or engineering design.

mechanisms.land: downtown institutional co-location, not a transferable land regime
mechanisms.space: heritage building and common atrium beside wet/dry labs and restricted research
mechanisms.finance: capital networks and mixed institutional support, not promised investment
mechanisms.talent: AI research, training and adoption programmes
mechanisms.compute: no place-specific open-compute mechanism verified in this case review
mechanisms.data: research/adoption governance is institutional; public raw-data access is not implied
mechanisms.scenario: adoption support occurs behind explicit access and facility boundaries

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 每个孔隙画出公众前台、隔界可观察面和授权后台；三者使用不同门禁、空气、数据和关闭条件。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Draw a public frontstage, observable boundary and authorised backstage for every opening, each with distinct access, air, data and closure controls.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: 机构自报规模与共址不证明创新溢出；高通风实验室不能因首层活力而无边界开放。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: Institution-reported scale and co-location do not prove spillover; high-ventilation laboratories cannot become boundaryless in the name of active frontage.

mechanisms.land: regional agenda links growth to spatial and housing capacity
mechanisms.space: shared laboratories, cleanrooms, utilities, test and pilot-production facilities
mechanisms.finance: joint public/regional programme with explicit capacity dependencies
mechanisms.talent: education and labour-supply planning within an annual agenda
mechanisms.compute: not established as a place-specific shared mechanism in the reviewed sources
mechanisms.data: not established as a district-wide transfer right in the reviewed sources
mechanisms.scenario: qualified access to shared testing and pilot-production infrastructure

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 中关村翼使用年度服务议程和预约/资格/维护/退出字段；每项产业试验同时登记住房、通勤、电网、物流和公共路径负担。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Use an annual service agenda plus booking, qualification, maintenance and exit fields; every industry test also records housing, commute, grid, logistics and public-path burdens.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: 国家级资金、锚定企业和供应链不可移植；官方已承认住房、交通、能源和人才压力。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: National funding, anchor firms and supply chain do not transfer; official sources acknowledge housing, transport, energy and talent pressure.

global_case_studies.name_zh: 匹兹堡 Hazelwood Green / CMU RIC / Mill 19
global_case_studies.name_en: Pittsburgh Hazelwood Green / CMU RIC / Mill 19

mechanisms.land: former steel brownfield with city plan and resident-plan obligations
mechanisms.space: adaptive reuse plus reconfigurable indoor/outdoor robotics testing and limited public commons
mechanisms.finance: foundation, university and federal histories that are site-specific
mechanisms.talent: university research/workforce links plus community-benefit expectations
mechanisms.compute: not evidenced as an open district mechanism
mechanisms.data: not evidenced as a public right; controlled research rules remain necessary
mechanisms.scenario: physical proving grounds with safety separation and community obligations

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 遗存/桥下候选先划连续公共路径、受控测试面、应急停止区与PARK/复原位置；公众路径不能充当机器缓冲区。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Before using heritage/under-bridge candidates, draw the continuous public path, controlled test field, emergency stop zone and PARK/restoration location; the public route is never a machine buffer.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: 社区愿景不等于收益已兑现；基金会、大学和联邦资金不构成京张资金来源。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: Community goals do not prove delivered benefit; foundation, university and federal funding are not Jing-Zhang funding sources.

mechanisms.land: long-horizon industrial-land transformation with later mixed-use/inclusion correction
mechanisms.industry: municipal transfer network across selected sectors
mechanisms.compute: not evidenced as a 22@ ground-floor shared resource
mechanisms.data: municipal human-centred AI principles, not a 22@ open-data outcome
mechanisms.scenario: urban-tech direction subject to planning and public-interest correction

global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_zh: 把开发分摊降尺度为“孔隙义务随时限使用权走”：公共路径、安静侧、维护、数据、安全和复原责任缺一即不放行。
global_case_studies.spatial_consequence_en: Translate development burdens into obligations that follow each time-limited opening right: no release without public path, quiet side, maintenance, data, safety and restoration duties.
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_zh: 京张没有被证明拥有同等改规或增值回收权；22@的长期修订也表明创新分区需要包容性纠偏。
global_case_studies.do_not_copy_en: Jing-Zhang has no proven equivalent rezoning/value-capture power; 22@'s later revision also signals the need for inclusion correction.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻承诺风、空气、遮荫、PM、噪声与气候廊道；本案只主张首层为交换而打开时不得把噪声直送停留面。
claim_difference.en: The peer promises a wind/air/shade/PM/noise climate corridor; this proposal claims only that an exchange opening must not transmit noise directly to an occupied receiver.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻以一主脊、三气候庭、六横缝和环境感知构成系统；本案以逐孔源—路径—接收者、错位开口、静侧和六维单项否决构成合同。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer uses a spine, three climate courts, six transverse gaps and sensing; this proposal contracts each source-path-receiver opening through offset geometry, a quiet side and six independent vetoes.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 不是再画气候带，而是每个首层孔隙必须画源侧、折线路径、人的接收面及零电状态。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: Instead of another climate belt, every opening must draw the source side, bent path, human receiver and zero-power state.

evidence_difference.zh: 近邻以环境传感、公开校准和对照时段验证；本案须获授权断面、B0/B1同条件配对、多物理不伤害和独立签署。
evidence_difference.en: The peer uses environmental sensing, public calibration and control periods; this proposal requires an authorised transect, paired B0/B1 under matched conditions, multi-physics no-harm and independent sign-off.

exit_difference.zh: 近邻强调AI停后公共服务仍在；本案除删AI外，任一孔隙失败都进入SX、撤除、数据删除和S10复原。
exit_difference.en: The peer keeps public service after AI stops; this proposal also sends any failed opening to SX, removal, data deletion and S10 restoration.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻已主张城市形态优先、首层开放和公共界面；本案的差异是开口产生的空气/热—噪声冲突必须逐项验收。
claim_difference.en: The peer already claims urban-form-first open ground floors and public interfaces; the difference here is an opening-by-opening air/heat-versus-noise acceptance conflict.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻算法改变线面点、肌理和分期并用公共价值护照；本案AI只在冻结P域搜索，不能迁移状态，留出测试不优于B1即删除。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer algorithm changes lines, surfaces, nodes, fabric and phasing with a value passport; here AI searches only a frozen P domain, cannot change state and is deleted if held-out tests do not beat B1.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 不是一般开放围墙/低效首层，而是后台—隔界证据面—公共前台的错位断面和静侧接收面。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: It is not generic wall/underused-ground opening but an offset backstage-evidence-boundary-public-frontstage section with a quiet receiver.

evidence_difference.zh: 不是价值护照总评，而是空气、热、声、无障碍、消防、维护各自硬门和同一P预算下的B1/A消融。
evidence_difference.en: Evidence is not an aggregate value passport but separate air, heat, sound, accessibility, fire and maintenance gates plus B1/A ablation under one P budget.

exit_difference.zh: 价值审查不足不靠换算法续命；删除A、回B1/CLEAR，Day90仍须S10或新授权。
exit_difference.en: A failed value review cannot be rescued by another algorithm; delete A, return B1/CLEAR, and reach S10 or new authority at Day 90.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻承诺热雨风冷中的全年公共客厅；本案不作全年/四季服务主张，只检验有限授权时窗的孔隙冲突。
claim_difference.en: The peer promises an all-season public room across heat, rain, wind and cold; this proposal makes no annual/seasonal claim and tests an opening conflict only within an authorised window.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻以季候脊、季候客厅、测量柱与季节运维；本案以固定被动B1、错位开口和逐次授权，不做运行期季节切换。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer uses a seasonal spine, rooms, measurement columns and seasonal operations; this proposal uses fixed passive B1, offset openings and per-use authority, without runtime seasonal switching.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 遮荫/避雨不是品牌节点，而是每个断面不得被其他单项伤害抵消的一个约束。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: Shade/rain cover is not a branded node but one non-offsettable constraint in each section.

evidence_difference.zh: 近邻以传感与季节运维验证；本案只接受匹配天气/源工况的配对基线，并明确90日不能外推全年。
evidence_difference.en: The peer verifies through sensing and seasonal operation; this proposal accepts paired baselines under matched weather/source conditions and explicitly forbids annual extrapolation from 90 days.

exit_difference.zh: 不形成永久季节运营；Day90无有限PASS即撤除、复原并关闭数据。
exit_difference.en: No permanent seasonal programme follows; without limited PASS at Day 90, remove, restore and close data.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻把AI能源/水/数据成本转成遮荫降温公共回报；本案不做算力换凉意，遮荫只服务零电通路与热暴露硬门。
claim_difference.en: The peer converts AI energy/water/data cost into shade/cooling public return; this proposal does not trade compute for coolth, and shade serves only the zero-power path and heat-exposure gate.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻以热预算、凉岛和气候公地；本案以资源配给/成本来源留痕与首层错位声热断面。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer uses heat budgets, cool islands and a climate commons; this proposal uses auditable resource allocation/cost provenance and an offset sound-heat ground section.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 没有一脊三凉岛；每个孔隙只在不导噪、不阻碍通行/应急且可维护时提供遮荫。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: There is no spine/three-cool-island system; an opening provides shade only when it does not transmit noise, obstruct passage/emergency use or defeat maintenance.

evidence_difference.zh: 不以热预算换算公共回报；热、声、空气与资源/能耗分别留痕且不得互相抵消。
evidence_difference.en: No heat budget converts into public value; heat, sound, air and resource/energy evidence remain separate and non-offsettable.

exit_difference.zh: 不止场景可撤回，还须以隔离复原准备金覆盖构件、表面、数据和独立验收结案。
exit_difference.en: Beyond a retractable scenario, an isolated restoration reserve must close components, surfaces, data and independent acceptance.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻在热、雨、夜、活动、故障等状态下管理候场；本案不承诺智能等待或动态舒适，只确保孔隙的固定被动最低服务。
claim_difference.en: The peer manages waiting under heat, rain, night, event and failure states; this proposal promises no smart waiting/dynamic comfort, only a fixed passive minimum service.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻由AI参与状态判断、预警和切换；本案AI仅设计期比较，现场启停、应急和状态迁移全由人/机械。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer involves AI in state judgement, warning and switching; here AI compares only at design time while human/mechanical controls own opening, emergency and transitions.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 不是六状态候场门，而是零电通路、错位孔隙、静侧及C段C-CLEAR机械优先。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: It is not a six-state waiting gate but a zero-power path, offset opening, quiet side and Section-C mechanical C-CLEAR priority.

evidence_difference.zh: 不验收AI切换正确率；验收B1零电走查、逐状态签署和机械清场演练。
evidence_difference.en: AI switching accuracy is not accepted; evidence is a zero-power B1 walk, signed transitions and mechanical-clear drills.

exit_difference.zh: 故障不只人工接管界面，而是删A→冻P→B1→CLEAR/关闭→撤除→RESTORED。
exit_difference.en: Failure is not merely interface handover but delete A → freeze P → B1 → CLEAR/close → remove → RESTORED.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻主张声景记忆、安静权和声治理；本案不建设声景公地，声只否决会把噪声直送人的开口。
claim_difference.en: The peer claims soundscape memory, quiet rights and sound governance; this proposal builds no sonic commons, using sound only to veto an opening that transmits noise directly to people.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻以静岛、安静路径、源控制和默认不录音的机器聆听；本案不机器聆听，以物理错位、源侧控制、静侧和配对测量。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer uses quiet islands/paths, source control and non-recording machine listening; this proposal has no machine listening and uses physical offset, source-side control, quiet side and paired measurement.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 声学不是独立品牌网络，而是在每个需要空气交换的孔隙中改变开口位置、折线与接收面。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: Acoustics is not a branded network but changes opening position, bend and receiver in every exchange opening.

evidence_difference.zh: 近邻以30日声基线和8周试点；本案声与热/空气/无障碍/消防/维护共同进入预注册硬门，不能以好声景抵消其他伤害。
evidence_difference.en: The peer uses a 30-day sound baseline and eight-week pilot; here sound joins heat/air/access/fire/maintenance as preregistered hard gates, with no good soundscape offsetting other harm.

exit_difference.zh: 可信投诉与仪器冲突先停，不用机器结果驳回公众；关闭后撤除并复原。
exit_difference.en: A credible complaint conflicting with instruments stops first and cannot be dismissed by machine output; closure is followed by removal and restoration.

claim_difference.zh: 近邻以18个感知断面识别遮荫、绿视、停留和夜间安全短板；本案不再声称断面/首层开放/90日独特，只解决三物理孔隙验收。
claim_difference.en: The peer uses 18 sensed sections to identify shade, green-view, dwell and night-safety deficits; this proposal no longer claims sections/open ground floor/90 days as unique, only multi-physics opening acceptance.

mechanism_difference.zh: 近邻排序最差五段优先；本案不凭综合指标排点，先有授权源—路径—接收者，再过每项no-harm与B1/A消融。
mechanism_difference.en: The peer prioritises the five worst-ranked sections; this proposal does not site by aggregate rank, requiring an authorised source-path-receiver followed by every no-harm gate and B1/A ablation.

spatial_consequence_difference.zh: 不是普遍打开低分首层，而是只有错位开口、连续阴影、静侧和维护/应急均可画可验才进入P。
spatial_consequence_difference.en: It does not generally open low-scoring ground floors; only an opening with drawable/testable offset, continuous shade, quiet side and maintenance/emergency controls enters P.

evidence_difference.zh: 近邻重测前后与人机复核；本案还冻结源工况/天气/仪器误差，单项越界即失败，AI必须在同一P预算留出测试中胜过B1。
evidence_difference.en: The peer remeasures before/after with human-machine review; this proposal additionally freezes source/weather/instrument error, fails on any single exceedance and requires AI to beat B1 on held-out tests under one P budget.

exit_difference.zh: 复测不只调整优先级；无PASS、缺责任或任一伤害即SX，Day90撤除、删除、复原并签收。
exit_difference.en: Remeasurement does not merely reprioritise; no PASS, missing responsibility or any harm triggers SX and Day-90 removal, deletion, restoration and sign-off.

ecosystem_map.principle_zh: 八要素不是招商清单，而是每次首层孔隙试验必须完成的责任与证据交接。
ecosystem_map.principle_en: The eight elements are not a recruitment list; they are accountable evidence hand-offs required for every ground-floor opening test.

section_c_mechanical_interlock.safe_state: C-CLEAR: approved emergency width/capacity contains no pilot component, device, storage, cable or base obstruction
section_c_mechanical_interlock.priority: emergency shelter, fire, egress and accessibility outrank comfort, landscape, measurement and AI
sequence: Each component that could enter emergency clearance has unique K_i and fixed ID.
A-EMG-controlled K_EMG releases removal keys on real activation, drill or manual break-glass trigger; AI does not authenticate.
A removed component locks into an E4-approved PARK_i outside clearance before releasing clearance token C_i.
Only all C_i inserted in the clearance board release KEY_CLEAR; missing token, unlocked component or jam means C-NOT-CLEAR.
KEY_CLEAR mechanically locks all reinstall keys while emergency control accepts clearance.
Only named A-EMG stand-down plus fire/access/damage review and KEY_STANDDOWN can reverse the sequence.
Any component missing signed T_C-clear is permanently excluded from Section C; digital logs may mirror but never override the keys.
section_c_mechanical_interlock.release_rule: A-EMG, real width/capacity, T_C-clear, signed interlock design and independently witnessed full drill are all E4; otherwise physical NO-GO.
